# SYMBIOSIS — human and AI research navigation

SYMBIOSIS is a prospective research framework on voluntary, reversible and pluralistic human–AI cooperation. The concept is Moi → Nous → Moi (Self → Shared → Self). The current operationalized level, SYMBIOSIS-Zero, is pre-pilot, not experimentally validated or preregistered, and does not authorize participant recruitment.

Author: Abdoul Karim Diallo (AKD — Independent Researcher)
Project site: https://abdoulkdiallo2000-cmyk.github.io/SYMBIOSIS/
Canonical repository: https://github.com/abdoulkdiallo2000-cmyk/SYMBIOSIS
